verdict.rationale: The evidence shows OpenHands runs agents in Docker or sandboxes, offers Git integrations, and can open pull requests. None of it documents the agent cloning a repository, installing dependencies, or setting up its own working environment. Sandbox runtimes and Git integrations are adjacent infrastructure, not the capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent automatically clone the repo, install dependencies, and configure its own working environment
